name: launch
description: A launch post: a hook, three features, then the price or the next step.

slots.brief: The promise or the problem, in one screen: what the app gives you. Usually the start page or the main screen. Caption: the benefit, not the app's name.
One feature per scene, each with one action the viewer can follow (a click, typing, a scroll). Caption: what the viewer gets from it.
The price, a plan or the sign-up screen. Caption: the price or the next step. If the app shows no price, its sign-up or start screen.

posts.tone: Plain and concrete: what it does and for whom. No hype.
